Schedule of Articles Subcontract No. B624801 Page 2 of 12 (DM-211; 02/01/17) LLNL-TR-2004972 ARTICLE 2 - SCOPE OF WORK A. The Subcontractor shall perform all construction work for Epoxy Floor Replacement, in accordance with this Subcontract. The Subcontractor shall provide all labor, material, equipment and supervision necessary to: B625 Truck Pit: • Prep 810sf of floor and 600sf of walls as needed by diamond grinding and removing any loose epoxy coating. • Apply one seal coat of Tera-Gem III Flex primer with embedded fiberglass to 810sf of floor, no walls • Trowel at nominal ¼” 810sf of floor only, no walls, using Tera-Gem III IFS. • Apply two pigmented seal coats of Tera-Gem III IFS Sealer to 810sf of floor and 600sf of walls • Apply one pigmented seal coat of Polyurethane 100 to 810sf of floor and 600sf of walls, color and finish texture to be selected by LLNS
